purpose: DESIGN ONLY, SHADOW. Owner decisions 2026-10-20 §1/§5: an informational disclosure; geom_q078_v1, canonical values, verdicts and fairness thresholds unchanged. Nothing here is served.

board.pinNote: the board is a function of the archive AND the CSV tree (source CSVs, scrape-state stamps, config/weights) the contract build reads; builtBoardSha256 hashes the resulting name -> canonical value map

fairnessBands.readThrough: fairness_bands.classify_packages (incumbent) / classify on fairness_base of the treatment's own package utilities (naive comparator); this script computes no band threshold or denominator

rules.A_dependence: the package a team RECEIVES holds >= 1 low-value depth (LVD) piece other than its single highest-valued piece, and removing those LVD pieces changes that team's fairness REGION (disfavoured / fair / favoured) under geom_q078_v1 + fairness_bands
rules.A_dependence_public: as A_dependence, but only a change of the public FAIR / NOT FAIR state counts (fair <-> not fair; a change of direction alone does not)
rules.A_guarded: A_dependence, and the team's own legs (what it receives plus what it gives, Rcv_i U Gv_i) hold >= 1 piece that is NOT low-value depth (a team whose legs are all low-value pieces never fires) - the guard was added after the unsweetened low-tier bases were seen firing (design §3.1), and is reported separately
rules.A_guarded_public: A_guarded with A_dependence_public's FAIR / NOT FAIR change
rules.A_guarded_publicFairOnly: A_guarded_public restricted to a team whose result is FAIR and becomes NOT FAIR without its LVD extras (never fires on a NOT FAIR result, so the disclosure cannot reveal which way a NOT FAIR trade leans - privacy M4).  OWNER OPTION ONLY, not recommended: when it fires it still leaks within-FAIR direction and, used as a per-asset oracle, the replacement anchors (design §9 R1/R2)
rules.B_share25: the received package has >= 2 pieces and its LVD pieces other than the top piece carry >= 25% of its raw priced value (X is a PRIOR, not tuned)
rules.C_extraPieces: the received package has more pieces than the package given in return, and at least one of its (n_received - n_given) lowest-valued pieces is LVD
rules.naive_B: COMPARATOR ONLY (research §11 rejected it): the B_currency_replacement treatment's signed level differs from GEOM_78's

lvdDefinition.prereg: players - not a genuine starter (league optimal lineup, or unrostered >= the lowest league starter at the position) and value < anchor[pos]; pick: value < anchor['*']
lvdDefinition.floor: players - value < min(anchor[pos], lowest league starter at pos); pick: value < anchor['*']
lvdDefinition.missing: no value, quarantined, no position or no anchor for the position = unclassifiable (UNKNOWN) -> the rule is NOT evaluated (no disclosure), never treated as zero or as low

topPieceTieBreak: highest value; ties go to the lowest canonical asset id (the player id, else the board name)

design.groups: '<cat>' = every case whose 1-4 sweeteners are of that §3 class (current anchors, the study's own labels); '|flip' = the incumbent verdict crosses a region for the sweetening side (the S3 primary flip, i.e. 'filler-caused flip' when cat = filler); '|noflip' = it does not; '|starterOnlyBase' = every base asset is a genuine starter; '|madeFair' = the sweeteners turned a result AGAINST the sweetening side into FAIR (the public 'unfair made fair' case)
design.sweetenerAttributable: fires on the SWEETENED package and did not fire on that same package before the sweeteners were added

reproduction.basis: the committed study (docs/valuation/evidence/low_value_assets_2026-10-20/shadow_replay.json S3) was built on the RETIRED fairness_bands_v1 basis (band on the larger ADJUSTED side).  Case generation is band-independent and must match exactly; flips and naive fires are reproduced on that v1 basis (low_value_asset_shadow_replay.verdict) to prove the same board and cases.  Every rule and table in this file uses the ACTIVE bands (*_activeBands below)

P2_calculatorSample.population: S5a: top-500 non-quarantined board assets; 1-3 v na..min(na+4,7); raw gap <= 25% of the larger side; values are % of trades on which the rule fires for either team

P3_ownLeagueTrades.population: every team side (got vs gave) of the own-league trades in the newest archive's sleeper.trades, valued with TODAY's board (not at-the-time values); a side is NOT evaluated (never priced at zero, never dropped) when it gives or receives nothing, or holds an unpriced, quarantined or unclassifiable piece; firePct is of the evaluated sides

P4_warRoom.note: rules are evaluated on the MARKET (asset-only) fairness of the trade; the served Team-Context verdict is reported beside it, never changed

workedExamples.case: Gibbs for Smith + Higgins + four ~1,000 fillers
Gibbs for six starters / usable depth
WR starter for IDP starter + two DB fillers
Early first for late first + two filler picks

packageModelParity.utilityGapTolerance: relative 1e-09 of the larger raw side
packageModelParity.adjustedTotalTolerance: 0.5 (adjusted_pair_totals rounds the adjustment to a whole number, js_round)
packageModelParity.note: every incumbent (GEOM_78) evaluation in every population was checked: the research utility gap equals package_model.geom_utility's and the research adjusted totals equal package_model.adjusted_pair_totals' within the tolerances above; any mismatch aborts the run.  Band: the owner's band (classify_packages, its own denominator) on the canonical utility gap must equal the research band; the comparison on the canonical WHOLE-NUMBER adjusted gap (same owner denominator) is informational, and differs only where rounding the adjustment crosses a cut point
